items.difficulty_reason: The proof is a two-fact composition: the identification \Hom_\mathcal{O}(j_!\mathcal{O}_U, \mathcal{F}) = \mathcal{F}(U) from the chapter's displayed equation for maps out of j_!\mathcal{O}_U, and the lemma that taking sections over a quasi-compact object commutes with direct sums (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact, carded locally as L30013). The statement is exactly the composite of the two, and both links are explicitly cited; the derivation is complete as written.
